t: The LAP Weyburn outdoor LED floodlight is a high-performance security light designed to illuminate exterior spaces with a powerful 15,000 lumen daylight output. This mains-powered wall-mounted fixture is ideal for garages, entrances and domestic driveways, providing a reliable security lighting solution. The robust aluminium body and glass diffuser feature an IP65 rating for weather protection. An integrated PIR motion sensor detects movement up to 10m away across a 120° range, while the adjustable dusk-to-dawn sensor and tiltable head allow precise control over when and where the light activates.
